sources.population: World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL (total, mid-year estimate), accessed Oct 2026
sources.fx_rate: World Bank WDI PA.NUS.FCRF (official rate, LCU per USD, annual average), accessed Oct 2026; USA fixed at 1.0

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection with one-line summaries

geopolitical_news.headline: Mumbai train bombings kill 209
geopolitical_news.summary: Seven coordinated blasts hit commuter trains on July 11, blamed on Pakistan-based militants; peace talks stall.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bush visit advances nuclear deal
geopolitical_news.summary: March visit seals the framework for the landmark India-US civil nuclear agreement.

geopolitical_news.headline: Nuclear deal triggers political crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: Left parties threaten to topple the UPA government over the deal; Manmohan Singh stakes his government on it.

geopolitical_news.headline: Samjhauta Express bombing kills 68
geopolitical_news.summary: February blasts on the India-Pakistan train deepen mistrust between the neighbours.

geopolitical_news.headline: 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks
geopolitical_news.summary: Ten gunmen kill 166 over four days in November; India-Pakistan relations freeze.

geopolitical_news.headline: India-US nuclear deal signed
geopolitical_news.summary: The 123 Agreement is signed in October, ending India's nuclear isolation.

geopolitical_news.headline: Congress wins second term
geopolitical_news.summary: UPA is re-elected in May with a stronger mandate; Manmohan Singh continues as PM.

geopolitical_news.headline: 26/11 trial opens
geopolitical_news.summary: Ajmal Kasab's trial begins in Mumbai amid global pressure on Pakistan.

geopolitical_news.headline: Obama backs India's UNSC bid
geopolitical_news.summary: November visit elevates the strategic partnership with US endorsement for a permanent Security Council seat.

geopolitical_news.headline: Commonwealth Games graft scandals
geopolitical_news.summary: Delhi's October Games are overshadowed by corruption allegations against organizers.

geopolitical_news.headline: Anna Hazare anti-corruption movement
geopolitical_news.summary: Mass August protests force the government to promise a Lokpal ombudsman bill.

geopolitical_news.headline: 2G spectrum scam rocks government
geopolitical_news.summary: The telecom scandal leads to arrests including a cabinet minister.

geopolitical_news.headline: Delhi gang rape sparks protests
geopolitical_news.summary: The December assault and death of a 23-year-old triggers mass demonstrations and tougher rape laws.

geopolitical_news.headline: Agni-V missile tested
geopolitical_news.summary: April test of the 5,000-km missile extends India's strategic reach.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rupee crashes in taper tantrum
geopolitical_news.summary: The rupee falls to record lows near 68 per dollar as foreign capital flees emerging markets.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mars Orbiter Mission launched
geopolitical_news.summary: November launch makes India the first Asian nation to reach Mars orbit.

geopolitical_news.headline: Modi sweeps to power
geopolitical_news.summary: BJP wins a single-party majority in May, the first in 30 years; Narendra Modi becomes PM.

geopolitical_news.headline: SAARC outreach to Pakistan
geopolitical_news.summary: Modi invites Pakistan's Nawaz Sharif to his swearing-in, raising brief hopes of a thaw.

geopolitical_news.headline: India signs Paris climate accord
geopolitical_news.summary: December deal commits India to ambitious renewable energy targets.

geopolitical_news.headline: Nepal blockade strains ties
geopolitical_news.summary: An undeclared blockade over Nepal's new constitution sparks Kathmandu's anger at Delhi.

geopolitical_news.headline: Uri attack and surgical strikes
geopolitical_news.summary: September militant attack kills 19 soldiers; India claims cross-LoC strikes days later.

geopolitical_news.headline: Demonetization shocks economy
geopolitical_news.summary: On November 8, Rs 500 and Rs 1,000 notes are scrapped overnight to fight black money.

geopolitical_news.headline: Doklam standoff with China
geopolitical_news.summary: A 73-day border face-off near Bhutan ends in August with mutual withdrawal.

geopolitical_news.headline: GST launched
geopolitical_news.summary: The Goods and Services Tax unifies India's market on July 1.

geopolitical_news.headline: India-US 2+2 dialogue debuts
geopolitical_news.summary: September talks deepen defence ties; the COMCASA pact is signed.

geopolitical_news.headline: Section 377 struck down
geopolitical_news.summary: Supreme Court decriminalizes homosexuality in a landmark September ruling.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pulwama attack and Balakot strike
geopolitical_news.summary: February suicide bombing kills 40 CRPF personnel; India bombs a militant camp in Pakistan.

geopolitical_news.headline: Article 370 revoked
geopolitical_news.summary: In August, Jammu and Kashmir's special status is scrapped and the state split in two.

geopolitical_news.headline: Galwan clash with China
geopolitical_news.summary: June border fighting in Ladakh kills 20 Indian soldiers; ties plunge to a historic low.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID lockdown strands millions
geopolitical_news.summary: A sudden nationwide lockdown in March leaves migrant workers walking hundreds of kilometres home.

geopolitical_news.headline: Delta wave devastates India
geopolitical_news.summary: The April-May second wave overwhelms hospitals amid severe oxygen shortages.

geopolitical_news.headline: Farm laws repealed
geopolitical_news.summary: After a year of farmer protests, Modi withdraws the three farm laws in November.

geopolitical_news.headline: India takes G20 presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: December handover sets up Delhi's 2023 summit as a diplomatic showcase.

geopolitical_news.headline: Russian oil imports surge
geopolitical_news.summary: Discounted Russian crude imports jump as Western sanctions reshape energy flows.

geopolitical_news.headline: Chandrayaan-3 lands on the Moon
geopolitical_news.summary: August landing near the lunar south pole makes India the fourth nation to soft-land.

geopolitical_news.headline: G20 summit in Delhi
geopolitical_news.summary: September summit produces a joint declaration despite divisions over Ukraine.

geopolitical_news.headline: Modi wins third term, weakened
geopolitical_news.summary: BJP loses its majority in June and governs through coalition for the first time.

geopolitical_news.headline: India-Canada row deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Tensions over Sikh separatism lead to tit-for-tat diplomat expulsions.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pahalgam attack and Operation Sindoor
geopolitical_news.summary: April terror attack kills 26 tourists; May strikes on Pakistan trigger a four-day military confrontation.

geopolitical_news.headline: US tariff tensions
geopolitical_news.summary: Washington's sweeping 2025 tariffs strain the bilateral trade relationship.
